selection_protocol.purpose: Check qualitative transfer across an autopilot, an RTOS, BMC firmware recipes, and radio firmware that do not appear in the earlier FUSE scan manifests.
selection_protocol.interpretation: A purposive source-only validation set. It is not representative, independently adjudicated, or an accuracy benchmark. Static signals do not establish shipped-product exposure or exploitability.
